method.inventory_key: PURL type/namespace/name@version; percent decode; restore epoch qualifier; strip 0:; RPM rhel=>redhat,rockylinux=>rocky,alma=>almalinux; PyPI -_. normalized; exclude file/operating-system; deduplicate locations
method.cve_key: inventory key | CVE; expand id+related_ids+record.aliases; NO manual Alma errata expansion
method.metric: /usr/bin/time -v, single run; scan+match excludes pull, includes local Docker read/SBOM/match; not cold-cache or repetition average
method.grype_once: one invocation per image, -o json=PATH -o cyclonedx-json=PATH
method.baseline_caveat: Alma baseline 40 CVE pairs used manual errata expansion; new 48 pairs expand only emitted ids; unchanged comparator CVE sets verified for all images
method.comparison_caveat: tool agreement is not accuracy; uncertain and vendor-policy states are not proof of exploitability

advisory_binary_or_branch_scope.verdict: Source/advisory CVEs applied to binary/older branch; OpenSSL CVE-2026-14456 contradicts pre-9.8 branch impact; all nine Alma FIPS CVEs explicitly exclude FIPS in Red Hat descriptions; remaining glibc/vim binary scope unresolved

advisory_release_cve_scope.verdict: 2 confirmed Jammy CVE-2026-19499 false positives; per-release cves_map excludes CVE and ubuntu.com says Not affected

redhat_unfixed_cve_coverage.verdict: Default RHSA-centered OSV lacks unfixed states; not all uncertain/will-not-fix entries imply proven vulnerability

vendor_libevent_feed_ingestion_differenc.verdict: Vendor errata/API confirm all eight CVEs with fixed 2.1.13-1.el9_8; Trivy missing; VEX snapshot reports affected with no fix although current API has fix

ubuntu_ignored_vendor_policy.verdict: Current ubuntu.com marks exact source/release Ignored; policy difference, not automatically false positive or confirmed Trivy miss

ubuntu_needs_evaluation_policy.verdict: Current ubuntu.com marks exact source/release Needs evaluation; OSV gives open range without status, bscan emits high confidence; no exploitability adjudication

redhat_unfixed_vendor_policy.verdict: Current API source states support Affected/Fix deferred/Under investigation; uncertain states are not confirmed vulnerabilities

redhat_negligible_policy.verdict: None mapped to NEGLIGIBLE and included by default; CVE-2026-19582 remains in archive but current API and VEX URLs return 404, current validity unresolved

vex_unlabelled_module_source_scope.verdict: 13 extra UBI8 Python RPM pairs; 5 overlap prior false-positive module set. VEX emits unlabeled source relationships while API scopes affected interpreter/modules; module guard cannot reject unlabeled vendor scopes. Exploitability not reproduced

vex_versioned_not_affected_scope.verdict: Version-specific acl-2.4.0 negative marker becomes unversioned and suppresses acl-2.3.1. Scope widening is proven; actual old-binary impact unresolved

vex_archive_snapshot_coverage.verdict: Two expat/CVE-2026-66046 pairs missing versus Grype; current API Affected and individual VEX modified Sep 15, record absent from Sep 13 archive-derived catalog

trivy_not_affected_false_positive.verdict: 16 pairs, 8 CVEs; current Red Hat API and VEX both say RHEL9 Not affected, Trivy reports affected/under-investigation

grype_redhat_namespace_vs_vendor_feed.verdict: Grype uses Red Hat namespace for Rocky/Alma; vendor-specific scope differs. Rocky krb5/CVE-2023-36054, CVE-2023-39975 and Alma pam/CVE-2026-54411 supported by vendor errata but missed by Grype. Other per-binary impact unresolved

feed_or_vendor_policy_difference.verdict: Source/triage/scope difference; supplementary Grype comparison is not ground truth. Red Hat API examples validate unfixed and under-investigation categories; not every exploit reproduced

unsupported_centos_stream.verdict: bscan/Trivy unsupported; Grype Red Hat namespace is not a validated CentOS Stream vulnerability oracle

bscan_binary_fingerprint_inventory.verdict: Generic binary evidence intentionally additional; not an OS package-version mismatch

bscan_deliberate_signing_key_exclusion.verdict: gpg-pubkey records intentionally excluded by bscan

trivy_omits_distro_owned_python_inventor.verdict: Python installation metadata retained by bscan/Grype, omitted by Trivy; bscan ownership property verified

trivy_unsupported_no_inventory.verdict: Trivy CentOS Stream unsupported, no inventory returned
